subject.title: feat(memory-lancedb): support reindex and drop-index command

question: Should the official `memory-lancedb` plugin expose an operator-facing command that removes all LanceDB table indexes, or should the supported workflow be limited to rebuilding the managed vector index?
rationale: The patch adds new user-facing maintenance commands rather than repairing an established command contract, and the broad deletion semantics are a durable product and support decision.

options.title: Limit to managed vector recovery
options.body: Keep `reindex` and replace or narrow `drop-index` so it only affects the plugin-managed vector index, with focused proof and help/docs.

options.title: Support all-index maintenance
options.body: Accept the broader command only with explicit all-index naming/help, operator documentation, and real proof showing the resulting table state.

options.title: Defer the CLI surface
options.body: Close or pause this feature until a maintainer sponsors a supported memory-lancedb maintenance workflow.

recommendation.title: Limit to managed vector recovery
recommendation.body: Keep `reindex` and replace or narrow `drop-index` so it only affects the plugin-managed vector index, with focused proof and help/docs.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history places this person on the current memory-lancedb implementation surface and release snapshot.
